name: ad-story-loops
description: Plan the question-and-payoff structure of an ad, promo, product demo or social marketing video so viewers keep watching for a reason and leave with the message: reveals written first, one central question, earned surprise, consequence, closure. Use when a brief asks for retention, hooks, open loops, story loops, curiosity gaps, rehooks, cliffhangers or a series of episodes, or when a cut loses viewers. Pairs with commercial-beat-sheet, explainer-storyboard, motion-ad, ugc-video and script-video, which own the beats and the look.
